verdict.rationale: The Nevada Secretary of State is a government filing service, not an agent, so it could plausibly publish an official MCP server and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The probes show only bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials) blocking keyless agents on both www.nvsos.gov and the ORION filing portal, so there is no evidence of any official agent connection path.
